title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Hardship Deferral Worksheet — Months Granted and Periods Covered
content:
**Months granted and coverage.** On a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the months granted start from the months asked on the request, and the deferral covers as many consecutive statement periods as the months granted, starting with the first statement period whose due date has not yet passed. The months granted are the months asked, adjusted for the account's record, and never more than the months asked nor below zero. The account's payment record adjusts the months: a record of sixteen or more adds two months, a record under six takes two months away, and any other record leaves the months alone. The payment record is the scheduled-payment entries posted in the twelve months before the grant less the payments returned unpaid in those twelve months.

The request answered is the most recent hardship request on the account whose status is submitted; the months asked are the months recorded on it.

## Worksheet lines

1. Months asked: from the most recent submitted hardship request on the account.
2. Payment record: the number of scheduled-payment entries posted in the 12 months before the grant, less the number of payments returned unpaid in those 12 months.
3. Record adjustment: plus 2 months for a record of 16 or more; less 2 months for a record under 6; none for a record of 6 to 15.
4. Months granted: line 1 with line 3 added, never more than line 1 and never below zero.
5. Periods covered: the first statement period whose due date has not yet passed on the grant day, and the consecutive periods after it, one for each month on line 4.

## Boundary cases of the record

| Payment record | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 16 | Plus 2 months |
| 15 | None |
| 6 | None |
| 5 | Less 2 months |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Months asked | Scheduled-payment entries in the 12 months | Returned in the 12 months | Payment record | Months granted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 12 | 0 | 12 | 2 |
| 2 | 12 | 1 | 11 | 2 |
| 2 | 18 | 0 | 18 | 2 (never more than the months asked) |
| 1 | 5 | 0 | 5 | 0 (never below zero) |

**Coverage (hypothetical dates).** Payments fall due on the 20th. On a grant of 2 months made on 12 May, the April due date has passed and the May due date has not, so the deferral covers May and June; on a grant made on 21 May it would cover June and July.
